remarks: Prime Location – This stunning home is situated in an amenity-rich community, within walking distance of shopping, restaurants, schools, and everyday conveniences, with easy access to Highway 2. Features a spacious open-concept main floor with 9’ ceilings and oversized windows, providing abundant natural light. Designed for Everyday Living – The main floor offers a welcoming great room with a cozy fireplace, rear kitchen, and large dining area, creating a seamless flow for living and entertaining. Modern Finishes Throughout – Enjoy quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry with 41” upper cabinets, and window coverings included for added privacy and convenience. Comfortable Upper Level – Upstairs, you’ll find a spacious primary bedroom with a private ensuite featuring a walk-in shower, two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and second-floor laundry. Detached Double Garage – Enjoy the convenience and additional storage of a rear detached double-car garage. Photos are representative. (id:67522)
